source: OWASP WSTG v4 Advanced + OWASP API Security 2023 + OWASP Mobile Security
description: QRadar SIEM alert rules mapped from WSTG-10 (Advanced), API Security (API1-API10), and Mobile Security (MASVS) test catalogs

rules.name: Race Condition - Double Withdrawal
rules.description: Detects concurrent withdrawal or payment requests indicating TOCTOU race condition exploitation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/withdraw%' OR URL ILIKE '%/transfer%' OR URL ILIKE '%/payment%') AND payload ILIKE '%POST%' GROUP BY sourceip, username, URL, devicetime LAST 5 MINUTES HAVING COUNT(*) > 2

rules.name: Race Condition - Double Coupon/Discount Application
rules.description: Detects rapid coupon application attempts indicating race condition exploitation for double discounts
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/coupon%' OR URL ILIKE '%/discount%' OR URL ILIKE '%/promo%') AND payload ILIKE '%POST%' GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 5 MINUTES HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

rules.name: Race Condition - Rate Limit Bypass
rules.description: Detects API requests exceeding rate limits indicating concurrent request abuse
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, COUNT(*) as request_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/auth%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/login%') GROUP BY sourceip LAST 1 MINUTES HAVING request_count > 100

rules.name: Race Condition - OTP Reuse Window
rules.description: Detects OTP authentication attempts within reuse window indicating race condition exploitation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(*) as otp_attempts FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/otp/verify%' OR URL ILIKE '%/2fa/verify%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 2 MINUTES HAVING otp_attempts > 2

rules.name: Race Condition - OAuth Code Reuse
rules.description: Detects OAuth authorization code reuse attempts indicating code replay race condition
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/oauth/token%' AND payload ILIKE '%code=%' GROUP BY sourceip, payload LAST 5 MINUTES HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

rules.name: Weak Hashing Algorithm Usage (MD5/SHA1)
rules.description: Detects use of weak hashing algorithms MD5 or SHA-1 in password storage or data integrity
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%$md5$%' OR payload ILIKE '%SHA1%' OR payload ILIKE '%$1$%' OR payload ILIKE '%md5hash%') AND (URL ILIKE '%/password%' OR URL ILIKE '%/hash%' OR URL ILIKE '%/verify%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Missing Password Hashing Detection
rules.description: Detects passwords stored or transmitted in cleartext without hashing
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/password%' OR URL ILIKE '%/reset-password%') AND (payload ILIKE '%password=%' AND NOT payload ILIKE '%hash=%') AND NOT payload ILIKE '%$2b$%' AND NOT payload ILIKE '%$2a$%' AND NOT payload ILIKE '%$6$%' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Hardcoded Cryptographic Key Detection
rules.description: Detects hardcoded encryption keys in source code, configuration files, or HTTP responses
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%AES_KEY=%' OR payload ILIKE '%SECRET_KEY=%' OR payload ILIKE '%ENCRYPTION_KEY=%' OR payload ILIKE '%PRIVATE_KEY=%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_config_service' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Padding Oracle Attack Detection
rules.description: Detects padding oracle attacks via unusual decryption error patterns with varied ciphertext
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, COUNT(DISTINCT payload) as variant_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/decrypt%' OR URL ILIKE '%/auth/token%') AND (payload ILIKE '%400 Bad Request%' OR payload ILIKE '%PaddingException%' OR payload ILIKE '%invalid padding%') GROUP BY sourceip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING variant_count > 30

rules.name: JWT Algorithm Confusion Attack (RS256→HS256)
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with algorithm confusion where RS256 token is verified as HS256
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Authorization' AND header_value ILIKE 'Bearer eyJ%' AND (header_value ILIKE '%"alg":"HS256"%' OR header_value ILIKE '%eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiU%') AND NOT header_value ILIKE '%"alg":"RS256"%' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Business Logic - Negative Price or Quantity
rules.description: Detects API requests with negative prices, quantities, or amounts indicating business logic manipulation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/order%' OR URL ILIKE '%/cart%' OR URL ILIKE '%/purchase%' OR URL ILIKE '%/payment%') AND (payload ILIKE '%"price":-%' OR payload ILIKE '%"quantity":-%' OR payload ILIKE '%"amount":-%' OR payload ILIKE '%"total":-%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Business Logic - Payment Bypass via Zero Amount
rules.description: Detects payment transactions with zero or minimal amounts indicating payment bypass attempts
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/payment%' OR URL ILIKE '%/checkout%' OR URL ILIKE '%/charge%') AND (payload ILIKE '%"amount":0%' OR payload ILIKE '%"amount":0.00%' OR payload ILIKE '%"total":0%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Business Logic - Gift Card/Credit Balance Manipulation
rules.description: Detects rapid gift card balance changes or credit manipulations indicating fraud
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/gift-card%' OR URL ILIKE '%/credit%' OR URL ILIKE '%/wallet/balance%') AND payload ILIKE '%POST%' GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

rules.name: API Mass Assignment - Role Elevation
rules.description: Detects API requests attempting to set admin role or permissions via mass assignment
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/profile%') AND (payload ILIKE '%"role":"admin%' OR payload ILIKE '%"isAdmin":true%' OR payload ILIKE '%"permissions":["admin"]%' OR payload ILIKE '%"user_type":"admin%') AND payload ILIKE '%PUT%' OR payload ILIKE '%PATCH%' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API Excessive Data Exposure in Response
rules.description: Detects API responses containing excessive fields (passwords, internal IDs, PII) beyond what the client needs
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/profile%') AND (payload ILIKE '%password%' OR payload ILIKE '%internal_id%' OR payload ILIKE '%salary%' OR payload ILIKE '%ssn%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_admin_service' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: GraphQL Introspection Query Exposure
rules.description: Detects GraphQL introspection queries exposing schema from non-developer sources
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/graphql%' AND (payload ILIKE '%__schema%' OR payload ILIKE '%__type%' OR payload ILIKE '%introspectionQuery%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_developer_subnet' LAST 6 HOURS

rules.name: GraphQL Depth/Complexity Abuse
rules.description: Detects deeply nested or highly complex GraphQL queries indicating DoS or data extraction
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, LONG(LENGTH(payload)) as query_size FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/graphql%' AND query_size > 5000 GROUP BY sourceip LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

rules.name: GraphQL Mutation Authorization Bypass
rules.description: Detects GraphQL mutations executed without proper authorization checks
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/graphql%' AND (payload ILIKE '%mutation%' AND (payload ILIKE '%deleteUser%' OR payload ILIKE '%updateRole%' OR payload ILIKE '%createAdmin%')) AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_admin_service' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: REST API HTTP Method Override
rules.description: Detects HTTP method override attempts using X-HTTP-Method-Override or _method parameter
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, header_value FROM events WHERE (header_name = 'X-HTTP-Method-Override' AND header_value IN ('PUT', 'DELETE', 'PATCH')) OR URL ILIKE '%_method=DELETE%' OR URL ILIKE '%_method=PUT%' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: REST API Pagination Abuse - Data Harvesting
rules.description: Detects API pagination abuse patterns requesting excessive pages of data in rapid succession
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users?page=%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/records?offset=%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/data?limit=%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 50

rules.name: WebSocket Unauthenticated Connection
rules.description: Detects WebSocket connections without proper authentication or with suspicious subprotocols
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE 'ws://%' OR URL ILIKE 'wss://%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.sourceip = events.sourceip AND e2.URL ILIKE '%/auth/token%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Microservice API Internal Endpoint Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to internal microservice API endpoints from external sources
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/internal/api/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/admin/api/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/service/internal/%' OR URL ILIKE '%:8080/api/%' OR URL ILIKE '%:9090/metrics%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'internal_microservice') LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: OAuth Authorization Code Replay Attack
rules.description: Detects reuse of OAuth authorization codes indicating code replay attacks
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/oauth/token%' AND payload ILIKE '%grant_type=authorization_code%' GROUP BY sourceip, payload LAST 5 MINUTES HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

rules.name: Supply Chain - Dependency Confusion Attack
rules.description: Detects npm/PyPI dependency confusion attacks where internal package names are resolved to public registries
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%registry.npmjs.org%' OR URL ILIKE '%pypi.org/simple/%') AND (URL ILIKE '%@internal/%' OR URL ILIKE '%@company/%') AND NOT destinationip = 'internal_registry' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: OAuth Scope Escalation via Parameter Tampering
rules.description: Detects OAuth authorization requests with scopes exceeding the authorized scope
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/oauth/authorize?scope=%' OR URL ILIKE '%/authorize?scope=%') AND (URL ILIKE '%scope=%admin%' OR URL ILIKE '%scope=%superuser%' OR URL ILIKE '%scope=%delete_all%' OR URL ILIKE '%scope=%write delete%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_admin_service' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API BOLA - IDOR on Sequential IDs
rules.description: Detects broken object level authorization via sequential ID enumeration on API endpoints
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(DISTINCT URL) as resource_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/1%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/orders/1%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/accounts/1%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING resource_count > 10

rules.name: API BOLA - Cross-Tenant Data Access
rules.description: Detects cross-tenant data access attempts in multi-tenant API systems
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/tenants/%/users%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/organizations/%/data%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_service' GROUP BY sourceip, username, URL LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT URL) > 5

rules.name: API Broken Authentication - Missing Auth on Endpoint
rules.description: Detects API requests without Authorization header on endpoints requiring authentication
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/orders%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/payments%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.sourceip = events.sourceip AND e2.header_name = 'Authorization') AND payload ILIKE '%GET%' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API Key in URL Query Parameter
rules.description: Detects API keys passed in URL query parameters vulnerable to logging and referrer leakage
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%?api_key=%' OR URL ILIKE '%?apikey=%' OR URL ILIKE '%?key=%' OR URL ILIKE '%?token=%' OR URL ILIKE '%?secret=%') AND NOT URL ILIKE '%/auth/callback%' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: API Mass Assignment on User Profile Update
rules.description: Detects mass assignment attacks on user profile update endpoints setting role or admin fields
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/profile%') AND (payload ILIKE '%PUT%' OR payload ILIKE '%PATCH%') AND (payload ILIKE '%"role"%' OR payload ILIKE '%"is_admin"%' OR payload ILIKE '%"permissions"%' OR payload ILIKE '%"group_id"%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API Password Hash in Response
rules.description: Detects API responses containing password hash fields that should not be exposed
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/profile%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (payload ILIKE '%password_hash%' OR payload ILIKE '%passwordHash%' OR payload ILIKE '%hashed_password%' OR payload ILIKE '%$2a$%' OR payload ILIKE '%$2b$%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API Rate Limit Exceeded - Authentication Endpoint
rules.description: Detects excessive requests to authentication endpoints indicating brute force or credential stuffing
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, COUNT(*) as request_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/auth/login%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/auth/token%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/authenticate%') GROUP BY sourceip LAST 5 MINUTES HAVING request_count > 50

rules.name: API Admin Function Access by Regular User
rules.description: Detects regular user accounts accessing admin-only API functions
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/admin%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/manage%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/superuser%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/config%') AND NOT username IN (SELECT username FROM REFERENCE_SET WHERE type = 'admin_users') AND payload ILIKE '%POST%' OR payload ILIKE '%PUT%' OR payload ILIKE '%DELETE%' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API Sensitive Data Exposure in Error Response
rules.description: Detects API error responses containing stack traces, database details, or internal paths
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%stack trace%' OR payload ILIKE '%SQLException%' OR payload ILIKE '%at com.%' OR payload ILIKE '%Internal Server Error%' OR payload ILIKE '%at org.%') AND (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API Unrestricted File Upload
rules.description: Detects file upload attempts with dangerous extensions to API endpoints
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/upload%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/files%') AND (payload ILIKE '%.php%' OR payload ILIKE '%.jsp%' OR payload ILIKE '%.exe%' OR payload ILIKE '%.sh%' OR payload ILIKE '%.aspx%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Mobile API - Cleartext HTTP Traffic
rules.description: Detects mobile API calls over unencrypted HTTP exposing credentials and data
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE 'http://%/api/v%' OR URL ILIKE 'http://%/auth%') AND NOT destinationport = 443 AND (header_name = 'User-Agent' AND (header_value ILIKE '%Mobile%' OR header_value ILIKE '%Android%' OR header_value ILIKE '%iPhone%')) LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Mobile API - Token in URL Query Parameter
rules.description: Detects mobile apps passing authentication tokens in URL query parameters
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%?token=%' OR URL ILIKE '%?access_token=%' OR URL ILIKE '%?session_id=%') AND (header_name = 'User-Agent' AND (header_value ILIKE '%Mobile%' OR header_value ILIKE '%Android%' OR header_value ILIKE '%iPhone%')) AND NOT URL ILIKE '%/auth/callback%' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Mobile API - IDOR on User Data
rules.description: Detects mobile API access to other users' data via sequential ID enumeration
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, COUNT(DISTINCT URL) as resource_count FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/1%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/profiles/1%') AND (header_name = 'User-Agent' AND header_value ILIKE '%Mobile%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 15 MINUTES HAVING resource_count > 10

rules.name: Mobile API - Hardcoded Secret Detection
rules.description: Detects API responses or requests containing hardcoded API keys or secrets from mobile clients
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%api_key=***%' OR payload ILIKE '%secret_key=***%' OR header_value ILIKE '%X-API-Key: ***%') AND (header_name = 'User-Agent' AND (header_value ILIKE '%Mobile%' OR header_value ILIKE '%Android%')) LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Mobile API - Deep Link Abuse
rules.description: Detects suspicious deep link patterns in mobile API requests that could enable unauthorized actions
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%://app/login?token=%' OR URL ILIKE '%://app/payment?amount=%' OR URL ILIKE '%://app/transfer?%') AND NOT sourceip = 'trusted_deep_link_source' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Mobile API - JWT Stored in LocalStorage
rules.description: Detects mobile web applications storing JWT tokens in localStorage instead of secure storage
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE payload ILIKE '%localStorage.setItem%' AND (payload ILIKE '%token%' OR payload ILIKE '%jwt%' OR payload ILIKE '%auth%') AND (header_name = 'User-Agent' AND (header_value ILIKE '%Mobile%' OR header_value ILIKE '%Android%')) LAST 6 HOURS

rules.name: Mobile API - Root/Jailbreak Device Detection Bypass
rules.description: Detects API calls from rooted/jailbroken mobile devices indicating security bypass
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/device/check%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/integrity%') AND payload ILIKE '%rooted=true%' OR payload ILIKE '%jailbroken=true%' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Mobile API - WebView JavaScript Interface Exposure
rules.description: Detects mobile WebView JavaScript interface exposure enabling unauthorized device access
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE payload ILIKE '%addJavascriptInterface%' AND (payload ILIKE '%window.Android%' OR payload ILIKE '%window.webkit%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_mobile_app' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: API Security Misconfiguration - Verbose Error Messages
rules.description: Detects API responses with verbose error messages exposing internal system details
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%Exception%' OR payload ILIKE '%stacktrace%' OR payload ILIKE '%at com.%' OR payload ILIKE '%at org.springframework%' OR payload ILIKE '%Caused by:%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API Security - Debug Mode Enabled
rules.description: Detects API debug mode enabled in production exposing internal routes and variables
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/debug%' OR URL ILIKE '%/_debug%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/debug%') AND (payload ILIKE '%debug=true%' OR payload ILIKE '%APP_DEBUG=true%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_developer_subnet' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: API Inventory Shadow Endpoint Access
rules.description: Detects access to undocumented or old API versions indicating shadow API inventory
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v1/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/internal/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/test/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/beta/%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_client' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: API Server-Side Request Forgery via API Parameter
rules.description: Detects SSRF attempts through API parameters targeting internal services or cloud metadata
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/fetch%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/proxy%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/webhook%') AND (payload ILIKE '%169.254.169.254%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://127.0.0.1%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://localhost%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://10.0.0.%' OR payload ILIKE '%http://192.168.%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API Server-Side Template Injection via API Input
rules.description: Detects SSTI attacks via API parameters using template expression syntax
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%{{7*7}}%' OR payload ILIKE '%${7*7}%' OR payload ILIKE '%<%= 7*7 %>%' OR payload ILIKE '%#{7*7}%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_scanner' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API Content-Type Confusion Attack
rules.description: Detects API requests with mismatched Content-Type headers attempting to bypass validation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, header_name, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Content-Type' AND (header_value ILIKE '%text/xml%' AND URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/json%') OR (header_value ILIKE '%application/json%' AND payload ILIKE '%<xml%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: API Batch/Async Operation Abuse
rules.description: Detects API batch or async operations abuse for resource exhaustion or data harvesting
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/batch%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/bulk%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/async%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 20

rules.name: GraphQL Subscription DoS
rules.description: Detects excessive GraphQL subscription connections causing resource exhaustion
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, COUNT(*) as sub_count FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/graphql%' AND payload ILIKE '%subscription%' GROUP BY sourceip LAST 5 MINUTES HAVING sub_count > 10

rules.name: Predictable Session Token Detection
rules.description: Detects patterns in session tokens suggesting weak random number generation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Set-Cookie' AND header_value ILIKE '%session%' GROUP BY sourceip, header_value LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT header_value) < 5

rules.name: HTTP/2 Desync via Extended CONNECT
rules.description: Detects HTTP/2 extended CONNECT method abuse for request smuggling
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, payload FROM events WHERE payload ILIKE '%:method CONNECT%' AND payload ILIKE '%:protocol%' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Prototype Pollution via API Mass Assignment
rules.description: Detects prototype pollution payloads in API requests targeting __proto__ or constructor
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%__proto__%' OR payload ILIKE '%constructor.prototype%' OR payload ILIKE '%prototype%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Supply Chain - Typosquatted Package Installation
rules.description: Detects installation requests for typosquatted npm/PyPI packages
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%registry.npmjs.org/%' OR URL ILIKE '%pypi.org/simple/%') AND (URL ILIKE '%lodash%' OR URL ILIKE '%reqeust%' OR URL ILIKE '%exrpess%' OR URL ILIKE '%djang0%' OR URL ILIKE '%pytlons%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: CI/CD Pipeline Secret Exposure
rules.description: Detects exposed CI/CD pipeline secrets, tokens, or configuration files in HTTP responses
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/.gitlab-ci.yml%' OR URL ILIKE '%/.github/workflows/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/Jenkinsfile%' OR URL ILIKE '%/docker-compose.yml%') AND (payload ILIKE '%secret%' OR payload ILIKE '%token%' OR payload ILIKE '%password%' OR payload ILIKE '%AWS_ACCESS_KEY%') LAST 1 HOURS
